Description: No regional lymph node involvement (no cancer found in the lymph nodes)
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there are malignant cells in regional lymph node(s) no greater than 0.2 mm and are detected by hematoxylin and eosin stain or immunohistochemistry.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is no evidence of regional lymph node metastasis histologically, and immunohistochemistry is negative.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is no evidence of regional lymph node metastasis histologically and by immunohistochemistry, but the molecular analysis (RT-PCR) is positive.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is no evidence of regional lymph node metastasis histologically and molecular analysis (RT-PCR) is negative.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases usually in a limited number of regional lymph nodes.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases usually in a limited number of regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N1a.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases usually in a limited number of regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N1b.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is metastasis to 1-3 nodes. The metastasis is greater than 2 mm and all are less than 20 mm.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is metastasis to four or more nodes. The metastasis is greater than 2 mm and all are less than 20 mm.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that the tumor extends beyond the lymph node capsule and is less than 20 mm.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that the metastases to the lymph nodes are more than 20 mm.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases usually in a limited number of regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N1c.
A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating the presence of micrometastases (greater than 0.2 mm and/or more than 200 cells, but none greater than 2.0 mm).
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in several regional lymph nodes.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in several regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N2a.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in several regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N2b.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in several regional lymph nodes, subclassified as N2c.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in multiple lymph nodes.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in multiple lymph nodes, subclassified as N3a.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in multiple lymph nodes, subclassified as N3b.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in multiple lymph nodes, subclassified as N3c.
A general term that refers to a TNM finding of cancer metastases in multiple lymph nodes, subclassified as N4.
